title: Product still life
subject: As described in the prompt
reverse_engineered_prompt: Create a premium lifestyle product still-life featuring a beautifully detailed vintage-inspired camera and a ceramic coffee cup arranged on a warm wooden tabletop. Compose the camera as the main subject with the lens facing the viewer, and place a coffee cup and a few restrained botanical props nearby. Use soft directional window light, warm beige and espresso-brown tones, controlled reflections on metal and glass, realistic material textures, gentle shadows, and an elegant commercial-photography finish. Keep the arrangement uncluttered with clear visual hierarchy. No brand names, readable text, logos, or watermark. 4:3 landscape composition.
